'''Bek''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the 35th Infantry under the command of [[Levet (clone)|Levet]]. Bek was called for by a wounded brother on [[Qiilura/Legends|Qiilura]].<ref name="True Colors" />
